heading: Navigate the foundation independently
intro: This page explains how to move through Legado de Diogenes with a keyboard, screen reader, light or dark theme, and optional high contrast while keeping the same learning content available to every student.

mainNavigation.title: Start from the main navigation
mainNavigation.content: Use the header links to move between Home, Learning Tracks, and Accessibility Help. Topic pages include a Back to learning tracks link so you can return to the track overview without retracing every previous step.

keyboardControls.title: Move through controls with the keyboard
keyboardControls.content: Press Tab to move forward through links, topic cards, the base theme switch, and the High contrast switch. Press Shift+Tab to move backward, then use Enter or Space to activate the focused item. The skip link moves focus directly to the main content.

headingsLandmarks.title: Use headings and landmarks as a page map
headingsLandmarks.content: Each page has a primary navigation region, one main content region, and clear headings for the current area. Screen reader users can jump by headings to compare tracks, find topic sections, and reach the next study action.

visualContrast.title: Switch to stronger visual contrast
visualContrast.content: Use the base theme switch to move between Light theme and Dark theme, then turn High contrast on or off independently. High-contrast mode strengthens text, borders, focus outlines, and button contrast without changing the content order. Current navigation state is also shown with text and underline, not color alone.

light.label: Light theme
light.purpose: Balanced color-safe reading for normal presentation use

light-high.label: Light high contrast
light-high.purpose: Light surfaces with stronger borders, focus indicators, and action contrast

dark.label: Dark theme
dark.purpose: Darker reading surfaces while preserving the same content and navigation

dark-high.label: Dark high contrast
dark-high.purpose: Dark surfaces with maximum separation for text, controls, and focus states
